meta.title: Wedding neon signs with your names, made in the UK | Lit Neon
meta.description: Custom LED neon wedding signs with your names or your line, sized for the top table or the backdrop. Made in a UK workshop, free mainland-GB delivery, and you approve a drawing first.

timeline.h2: Order four weeks before the day
timeline.body: The drawing takes a day, making takes 7–10 working days after you approve it, and a week spare covers the post and a change of heart about the colour.

steps.d: Your drawing comes back within 12 hours
Time to test it and plan where it hangs

timeline.answerTight: Order and approve your drawing by {date}. It arrives in time, though without a spare week, so don't leave it later.
timeline.answerRush: That's sooner than our standard making time. Ask us about a rush job and we'll tell you honestly what's possible.

after.h2: It doesn't go back in the box
after.body: The sign from the backdrop becomes the one above the bed or along the hallway. Drag across to see it by day, switched off, and by night.

grid.lede: Lines couples ask for most, each in any of our 12 tube colours and five sizes.

events.h2: Signs for every wedding you host
events.body: Several signs for a venue, a run of events or a hire stock, quoted together with one proof per design and staged delivery when you need it.
